blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present TimeBraid, a series of unified time-series and language models that align pretrained language models and pretrained time-series foundation models through interleaved global residual attention layers. Each model inherits knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning from one side, continuous-signal perception and zero-shot forecasting from the other, and fuses the two in a shared representation space where both modalities are understood and generated. We study the design choices that make such unified modeling work: where to align the two representation spaces, how to ground language in temporal structure, how to balance understanding with generation, and how to keep joint optimization stable. The resulting recipe combines a unified prompting scheme for diverse time-series and text tasks, stabilized joint training, and supervision from 2.2M curated series–text pairs and 4.9M instruction-tuning samples.
Across benchmarks spanning time-series perception, understanding, reasoning, and both context-aided and unimodal forecasting, TimeBraid remains competitive with far larger general-purpose models and task-specific counterparts.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍TimeBraid,这是一系列统一的时间序列和语言模型,通过互换的全球剩余关注层,使预先训练的语言模型和预先训练的时间序列基础模型保持一致. 每个模型都继承知识,遵循指令,并从一方得到推理,从另一方得到连续的信号感知和零镜头预报,并将两者融合在一个共同的表示空间中,使两种模式都得到理解和产生. 我们研究使这种统一的建模发挥作用的设计选择:将两个代表空间放在哪里,如何在时间结构中铺设语言,如何平衡理解和生成,以及如何保持联合优化的稳定. 由此产生的配方结合了针对不同时间序列和文本任务的统一提示计划,稳定的联合培训,以及从2.2M编译的系列文本对和4.9M教学调试样本中进行监督.
在跨越时间序列、理解、推理以及环境辅助和单一模式预测的基准中,TimeBraid仍然具有竞争力,与更大的通用模式和具体任务对应方竞争。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: From early development, human intelligence is shaped by continuous interaction with a rich stream of heterogeneous signals. Vision, audition, language, and tactile sensation arrive as synchronized time series, allowing information from one modality to contextualize and complement information from others ( Smith and Gasser, 2005 ; Smith et al., 2018 ; Orhan et al., 2020 ) . Existing efforts to build multimodal systems have largely relied on composed workflows or architectures that merge separately developed, modality-specific modules. Unified multimodal models explore a complementary direction: learning shared representations for understanding and generating heterogeneous signals within a single set of model weights ( Team, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; An et al., 2026 ) . Emerging evidence suggests that joint pretraining across modalities may foster capabilities that are difficult to acquire from any individual modality in isolation ( Tong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 从早期发展开始,人类智能的形成是通过与丰富多彩的信号流的持续相互作用. 视觉,试镜,语言,和触觉感知作为同步时间序列而来,使得信息从一种模式到背景化和补充来自其他方式的信息(Smith和Gasser,2005年;Smith等人,2018年;Orhan等人,2020年). 建立多式联运系统的现有努力主要依靠由工作流程或结构构成的工作流程或结构,这些工作流程或结构合并了单独开发的、针对具体模式的模块。 统一的多式联运模式探索一个互补方向:学习共同的表示方法,以便理解和在单一的一套模式权重范围内产生不同的信号(Team,2024;Zhou等人,2025a); 谢等人,2025年a; 王等编,. 2024;Chen等人,2025b;Deng等人,2025;徐等人,2025a; An et al., 2026 ) (中文(中国大陆) ). 新出现的证据表明,跨模式的联合预训可能增强孤立地从任何个别模式中难以获得的能力(Tong等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: However, time-series data remains largely outside this unification. Numerical records of dynamical systems (e.g., physiology, power grids, markets, and climate) lack the semantic context for identification and interpretation ( Goldberger et al., 2000 ; Hong and Fan, 2016 ; Tsay, 2010 ; Lam et al., 2023 ; Shallue and Vanderburg, 2018 ) . Language grounding can supply this context and connect time series with broader world knowledge, motivating their inclusion as an essential modality in unified models.
blocks.zh: 然而,时间序列数据基本上仍未实现统一。 动态系统的数值记录(如生理学,电网,市场和气候)缺乏识别和解释的语义背景(Goldberger等人,2000年;Hong and Fan,2016年;Tsay,2010年;Lam等人,2023年;Shalue and Vanderburg,2018年). 语言定位可以提供这种背景,并将时间序列与更广泛的世界知识联系起来,促使它们作为基本模式纳入统一模式。

blocks.en: Existing approaches typically connect time series and language by adding specialized components, ranging from projection layers to signal tokenizers, to pretrained language or time-series models ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Guan et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . However, such components introduce representational gaps, causing semantic misalignment and degrading pretrained capabilities, and each resulting system covers only a fragment of the full bidirectional interface (Section 5 ). Aligning the native representations of both pretrained hosts while largely preserving their capabilities remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通常通过添加从投影层到信号示标器的专用组件来连接时间序列和语言,以及预先训练的语言或时间序列模型(Xie等人,2024年;Guan等人,2026年a; Jin等人, 2024; Wang等人, 2025a). 然而,这些组件引入了代表差距,导致语义错配和降低预先训练的能力,每个产生的系统只涵盖完整双向接口的一个片段(第5节)。 调整两个事先受过训练的东道主的本地代表,同时在很大程度上保持其能力,仍然没有得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: Such alignment requires large-scale paired pretraining, yet the inherent semantic gap between continuous signals and discrete language makes it challenging. To bridge this gap, we present TimeBraid , a mixture-of-Transformers architecture that combines modality-specific processing with cross-modal context sharing. Inspired by how specialized sensory organs perceive different signals while the brain integrates them for decision-making, TimeBraid employs separate pretrained experts for language reasoning, time-series perception, and forecasting, while connecting them through global residual attention . This mechanism organizes their representations into a shared chronological context, enabling cross-modal interaction while substantially preserving pretrained language and forecasting capabilities. Building on this architecture, we introduce a two-stage training recipe that first aligns time series and language on large-scale paired data and then adapts the unified model to diverse downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 这种对齐需要大规模对齐预训,然而连续信号和离散语言之间固有的语义差距使其具有挑战性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们介绍了TimeBraid,一种转换器混合结构,将特定模式的处理与跨模式上下文共享结合起来。 TimeBraid利用不同语言推理、时间序列感知和预测专家, 这一机制将其表述安排在一个共同的时间顺序上,从而能够进行跨模式互动,同时实质性地保留预先培训的语言和预测能力。 在这个架构的基础上,我们引入了两阶段的训练食谱,首先在大规模配对数据上协调时间序列和语言,然后根据不同的下游任务调整统一模型.

blocks.en: Across twelve understanding and forecasting benchmarks ( Jing et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2024 ; Weng et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Williams et al., 2024 ; Aksu et al., 2024 ) , TimeBraid at 1.2B–6.7B parameters serves both directions of the series–text interface in one model, as summarized in Figure 1 . For understanding, TimeBraid-6.7B reaches 80.65% on TSAQA, compared with 85.26% for TSAQA-specific LLaMA3.1-8B SFT and 63.10% for GPT-5.4. On the held-out TB-MCQ suite it performs on par with GPT-5.4 (36.58% vs. 38.50%). Its CaTS-Bench captions match the strongest frontier VLMs and the models finetuned on the benchmark. For forecasting, TimeBraid attains the best average MSE rank on the nine Time-MMD domains and the best CRPS on CAF. On GIFT-Eval it largely maintains comparable zero-shot forecasting to state-of-the-art time-series foundation models. It is also the only non-LLM model whose Ctrl-F forecasts follow the stated condition, and attains the best Macro MSE and Macro MAE on CGTSF. Further analysis systematically ablates the design space of this new model class and singles out the shared attention space, stabilized joint optimization, and the alignment stage as the choices that matter most. Together, these results establish TimeBraid as a series of powerful and versatile unified models of time and language.
blocks.zh: 跨越12项理解和预测基准(Jing等人,2026年;Cai等人,2024年;Weng等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2026年;Liu等人,2024年a;Wang等人,2025年a;Zheng等人,2026年;Williams等人,2024年;Aksu等人,2024年),TimeBraid at 1.2B-6.7B参数在一个模型中服务于系列文本界面的双向,如图1所汇总. 为了解情况,TimeBraid-6.7B在TSAQA上达到80.65%,而TSAQA特有的LLaMA3.1-8B SFT为85.26%,GPT-5.4%为63.10%. 在被搁置的TB-MCQ套房中,它与GPT-5.4(36.58%对38.50%)相同。 它的CATS-Bench字幕匹配最强的边疆VLM和在基准上微调的模型. 就预测而言,TimeBraid在9个Time-MMD域上取得了最佳平均MSE排名,在CAF上取得了最佳CRPS排名. 在GIFT-Eval上,它基本上维持了与最先进的时序基础模型相当的零射预测. 这也是Ctrl-F的预测遵循所声明条件,并在CGTSF上获得最佳Macro MSE和Macro MAE的唯一非LLM模型. 进一步的分析系统地缩小了这个新模型类的设计空间,并单挑出共享的注意力空间,稳定了联合优化,对接阶段是最重要的选择. 这些成果共同将TimeBraid确立为一系列强大的多功能统一的时间和语言模型.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 初步情况

blocks.en: Every time-series and language task can be described as an interleaving of the two modalities. Formally, an example is a segment sequence S = ( s 1 , … , s M ) S=(s_{1},\dots,s_{M}) , where each segment is either a text segment (a token sequence) or a time-series segment (a univariate value sequence ( x 1 , … , x n ) ∈ ℝ n (x_{1},\dots,x_{n})\in\mathbb{R}^{n} ; a multivariate series enters as one segment per variable), and each segment is designated as context or target ; the number and ordering of segments are unconstrained. Context segments are fully observed: context text s text s_{\mathrm{text}} carries instructions, questions, and background, and a context time-series segment s ts , C s_{\mathrm{ts},C} carries observed measurements. Target segments are the model’s outputs: a target text segment is a language response to be generated, and a target time-series segment s ts , T = ( x 1 , … , x h , x h + 1 , … , x h + f ) s_{\mathrm{ts},T}=(x_{1},\dots,x_{h},x_{h+1},\dots,x_{h+f}) restates the observed history ( x 1 , … , x h ) (x_{1},\dots,x_{h}) of its context segment and continues it with f f future values to be generated.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: TimeBraid is a unified time-series and language model built on top of native language and time-series representations: a pretrained language model and a pretrained time-series foundation model. Its design pursues two properties: (i) the framework should be an omni learner and practitioner, not bound by a specific task format, accepting any time-series and text segment composition in input and output; and (ii) it should leverage the pretrained representations in existing language models and time-series foundation models rather than relearning them from scratch. We first describe the data recipe that develops these capabilities, then the unified prompting and model design that realize (i) and (ii), and finally the training objectives, optimization setup, and inference procedure.
blocks.zh: TimeBraid是一个统一的时序和语言模型,建立在本土语言和时序表示之上:一个经过预先训练的语言模型和一个经过预先训练的时间序列基础模型. 其设计追求两个特性:(一) 框架应当是全科学习者和从业者,不受具体任务格式的约束,在投入和产出中接受任何时间序列和文本段组成;(二) 利用现有语言模型和时间序列基础模型中经过预先培训的表述,而不是从零开始重新学习。 我们首先描述了开发这些能力的数据配方,然后是实现(一)和(二)的统一提示和模型设计,最后是培训目标,优化设置和推论程序.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Recipe
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据路径

blocks.en: Our data is arranged as a two-stage curriculum (Figure 2 ). The first stage teaches basic time-series understanding and controllable forecasting on constructed paired data. The second stage builds on these basics and targets instruction following, task-specific performance, and real-world domain knowledge with a heterogeneous instruction mixture.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据被安排为两个阶段的课程(图2)。 第一阶段教授基本的时间序列理解和可控制的对成对数据的预测。 第二阶段借鉴了这些基础和目标指导、具体任务的业绩以及具有多样化指导混合物的现实世界域知识。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Two-stage training recipe. Stage 2 counts show the final one-pass sample inventory, while percentages show training-time sampling shares.
blocks.zh: 图2:两阶段培训方法。 第2阶段的计数显示最后的一次性抽样清单,而百分比显示培训时间抽样份额。

blocks.en: The alignment stage uses 2.23M paired examples, split 3:7 between understanding and forecasting. The understanding data covers both univariate and multivariate cases: morphology captions describe the basic structures of a single series (trends, seasonality, regimes, salient features, inter-series relationships); context-rich captions describe real series together with their real-world context; programmable captions in the style of ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2024 ) are generated attribute-first, so each description matches its series precisely by construction; multivariate examples are generated from structural causal models with known interaction structure; and templated programmable tasks ( Cai et al., 2024 ) cover the same content from diverse task perspectives. The forecasting data focuses on controllability and is built with future-aware annotation: annotations are produced with access to the future, which is never included in the model input. The forecasting control set synthesizes several distinct futures from one shared history using programmable operators and captions the condition that leads to each future, so the model learns to follow stated conditions when forecasting. The general forecasting set annotates realized futures of real series, aligning context-conditioned forecasts with natural real-world evolution. We rewrite some forecasting examples in different tones and genres to make their presentation more diverse and realistic. Appendix A details the construction of each family.
blocks.zh: 配对阶段采用2.23M配对实例,在理解和预测之间分为3:7. 理解数据既涵盖单变量,也涵盖多变量案例:形态学标题描述单一系列的基本结构(趋势,季节性,制度,显著特征,序列间关系);内容丰富的标题描述真实系列及其真实世界背景;ChatTS风格的可编程标题(Xie等人,2024年)生成属性第一,因此每个描述都通过构造精确地与其系列相匹配;多变量实例来自已知相互作用结构的结构因果模型;模板可编程任务(Cai等人,2024年)从不同任务角度覆盖相同内容. 预测数据注重可控性,采用未来知觉注解构建:说明制作时可访问未来,而模型输入中从未包含. 预测控制集使用可编程运算符将一个共享历史中的几个截然不同的未来进行合成,并对通往每个未来的条件进行说明,因此模型在预测时学会了遵循声明的条件. 总体预测设定了真实系列实现的未来的注释,将上下文条件的预测与自然现实世界演化相配合. 我们用不同的音调和流派改写一些预测实例,使其表述更加多样和现实. 附 录 详细介绍每个家庭的建设情况。

blocks.en: The second stage uses a heterogeneous mixture spanning time-series question answering and reasoning, captioning and description, contextual and unimodal long-horizon forecasting, and domain-specific applications in energy, climate, healthcare, finance, sensing, and industrial monitoring. Its final one-pass inventory contains 4,881,583 samples. The training-time sampling shares allocate 54.49% to forecasting, 22.49% to time-series QA and reasoning, 3.34% to captioning and description, 11.69% to unimodal data, and 8.00% to alignment retention. The retained alignment quota contains 614,113 samples: 116,294 from understanding and 497,819 from forecasting.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段采用多种混合方式,包括时间序列问题回答和推理、标题和说明、背景和单模式长视距预测以及能源、气候、保健、金融、遥感和工业监测领域的具体应用。 其最后的单程盘点包含4,881,583个样本. 培训时间抽样占预测的54.49%,占时间序列QA和推理的22.49%,占标题和说明的3.34%,占单式数据的11.69%,占8.000%。 保留的对齐配额包含614,113个样本:116,294个来自理解,497,819个来自预测.

blocks.en: 3.2 Unified Time-Series and Language Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2 统一时间序列和语言建模

blocks.en: The prompting scheme defines the serialization S ↦ u 1 : T S\mapsto u_{1:T} , mapping a segment sequence (Section 2 ) to the mixed sequence of T T text tokens and time-series patches that the model consumes. Each example is rendered as a chat transcript in the native chat template, and time-series segments are wrapped with special tokens <ts></ts> (as illustrated in the examples below). Each context time-series segment is prepended with a statistics block indicating the length, mean and standard deviation of the segment, and each target segment is a bare <ts></ts> . The text segments are tokenized into text tokens and the time-series segments are normalized and tokenized into patches of fixed length P P , according to the pretrained language model and time-series foundation model respectively. For the context time-series segments, we use full-segment normalization. For a target time-series segment, we normalize the full segment with the statistics of its history prefix and then apply a rolling RevIN normalization ( Kim et al., 2022 ) to better handle nonstationarity and respect the causal order in the prediction process. The global sequence ordering is determined by the chronological order of the original segment sequence. The examples below show one multivariate understanding and one univariate forecasting transcript.

blocks.zh: 图3 TimeBraid架构:模式组件和时间序列与语言模式之间的信息流动.

blocks.en: The core part of TimeBraid is a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that unifies time-series perception, reasoning and forecasting within a single framework. The perception expert encodes context time-series segments, the reasoning expert handles text input and output such as instructions and language responses, and the forecasting expert generates target time-series segments based on the time-series and text contexts. We initialize the experts with their corresponding pretrained models, e.g., large language models and time-series foundation models. Note that while the perception and forecasting experts receive different input with different normalization, they can share the same underlying model (dual-tower architecture). One may also consider using different backbones (tri-tower architecture) to further disentangle the representations used for understanding and forecasting, analogous to unified vision models that decouple understanding from generation representations ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . However, we do not observe significant performance improvement by using extra backbones in ablation studies (Figure 4 E). The choice of backbone for each expert tower is not limited under this framework, and we leave the study of model composition as future work.

The map is linear near zero and logarithmic in the tails, so extreme targets are compressed into a bounded range. Second, loss capping : the time-series loss of each response is rescaled by the detached factor s = min ⁡ ( 1 , c / stop ​ _ ​ gradient ⁡ ( ℓ ) ) s=\min\!\big(1,\,c/\operatorname{stop\_gradient}(\ell)\big) , where ℓ \ell is the response’s time-series loss value and c c is a fixed cap threshold (Appendix C ). blocks.en: We evaluate TimeBraid on time-series understanding and forecasting, covering perception, question answering and reasoning, contextual description, and contextual, controlled, and unimodal forecasting. Comparisons include general-purpose language and vision–language models, specialized time-series models, and unified models. Evaluation protocols, data sources, relationships to the training mixture, and complete results are detailed in Appendices B.3 , E , and F . In main-text tables, bold and underlining mark the best and second-best values in the primary comparison. Detailed appendix tables also mark third-best values with daggers. Dashes indicate unavailable or non-comparable results.

blocks.en: The time-series understanding results are summarized in Table 1 . TSAQA poses multi-format questions about a presented series, from perception subtasks such as anomaly detection and classification to reasoning subtasks such as temporal relations and ordering. TimeSeriesExam and the TemporalBench multiple-choice suite (TB-MCQ) are exams of time-series concepts and temporal reasoning. TimeBraid-6.7B achieves 80.65% overall TSAQA accuracy, compared with 85.26% and 84.29% for the benchmark-specific fine-tuned LLaMA3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B ( Jing et al., 2026 ) , and 63.10% for GPT-5.4. TimeBraid-2.5B and TimeBraid-1.2B achieve 78.31% and 76.61%. All three variants remain competitive on TB-MCQ, with TimeBraid-6.7B landing within two points of GPT-5.4. TimeOmni-VL obtains 39.27% on TSAQA and 49.06% on TimeSeriesExam, where TimeBraid-6.7B reaches 63.14%. Per-category breakdowns are provided in Tables 12 , 13 , and 16 .
blocks.zh: 表1概述了时间序列理解结果。 TSAQA对呈现的系列提出了多格式的问题,从感知子任务如异常检测和分类到推理子任务如时间关系和顺序. TimeSeriesExam和Temporal Bench多选择套件(TB-MCQ)是对时间序列概念和时间推理的考试. TimeBraid-6.7B的总TSAQA精度达到80.65%,而具体基准微调LLaMA3.1-8B和Qune3-8B(Jing等人,2026年)的精度分别为85.26%和84.29%,GPT-5.4%的精度为63.10%. TimeBraid-2.5B和TimeBraid-1.2B的精度达到78.31%和76.61%. 所有三种变体在TB-MCQ上仍然具有竞争力,TimeBraid-6.7B在GPT-5.4的两个点内着陆. TimeOmni-VL在TSAQA获得39.27%,在TimeSeriesExam获得49.06%,TimeBraid-6.7B达到63.14%. 按类别分列的细目见表12、13和16。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports contextual description results on the CaTS-Bench human-rewritten split, where the model writes a caption for a series given its background context, scored for alignment with human references and for the fidelity of the numbers it cites. In the primary comparison, TimeBraid-6.7B ranks second on DeBERTa-F1, BLEU, and ROUGE-L and achieves the best SimCSE, while TimeBraid-2.5B remains second or third on the same alignment metrics. All three variants lead every other series–text model by a wide margin on every alignment metric. Numeric fidelity is their weakest axis, below the general-purpose models. The gap is expected: the time-series backbone compresses each patch of 32 raw values into a single embedding, and this reduction preserves shape and dynamics but loses fine-grained local values. Results for all evaluated models are reported in Table 14 .

blocks.en: Table 3 reports contextual forecasting on real-world benchmarks, where TimeMMD and CGTSF pair series from domains such as health, energy, and traffic with aligned text. Among the models shown in this summary table, a TimeBraid variant ranks among the top three on eight of the nine TimeMMD domains. TimeBraid attains the best Macro MSE and Macro MAE on CGTSF. Detailed results are provided in Tables 18 and 19 .

blocks.en: Controlled forecasting examines whether language can direct a model’s numerical predictions (Table 4 ). We introduce Ctrl-F, a controlled-forecasting evaluation set built from histories in the GIFT-Eval test set ( Aksu et al., 2024 ) , with multiple deterministic, text-conditioned synthetic continuations for each history. TimeBraid-6.7B achieves 43.33% Top-1 accuracy against a 33.33% chance level, showing that textual conditions can guide its numerical forecasts. CAF and CiK extend the evaluation to forecasting with informative scenarios and contextual knowledge. TimeBraid-6.7B achieves the lowest pooled CRPS on CAF, while TimeBraid-2.5B performs comparably to the strongest listed time-series foundation model on CiK. We see that the strongest LLMs remain ahead on Ctrl-F and CiK because they can easily convert the control signal to output and have the advantages of deep reasoning.
blocks.zh: 控制预测审查语言能否引导模型的数字预测(表4). 我们介绍Ctrl-F,这是根据GIFT-Eval测试集(Aksu等人,2024年)中的历史构建的可控预测评价集,每个历史都有多个定型,文字条件的合成续作. TimeBraid-6.7B在33.33%的概率水平上达到43.33%的Top-1精度,表明文字条件可以指导其数值预测. CAF和CiK将评价扩大到具备信息化情景和背景知识的预测。 TimeBraid-6.7B在CAF上实现最低集合CRPS,而TimeBraid-2.5B在CiK上与最强的列出时间序列的基础模型进行对比. 我们看到Ctrl-F和CiK上最强的LLMs仍然领先,因为它们可以很容易地将控制信号转换成输出,并具有深层推理的优点.

blocks.en: TimeBraid also supports competitive short-term and long-term forecasting from numerical histories alone (Tables 5 and 6 ). On GIFT-Eval ( Aksu et al., 2024 ) , which spans diverse series and forecast lengths, it outperforms the listed statistical and task-specific supervised baselines, while the strongest specialized forecasting foundation models remain ahead. On the long-horizon ETT and Weather benchmarks, TimeBraid-2.5B achieves the second-best average MSE rank and third-best average MAE rank. We see that it largely preserves the unimodal forecasting capability from TimesFM2.5, and the gap is expected to be reduced by a more balanced data recipe.
blocks.zh: TimeBraid还支持仅从数字历史中进行具有竞争力的短期和长期预测(表5和表6)。 GIFT-Eval(Aksu等人,2024年)跨越不同的系列和预测长度,它的表现超过了列出的统计和特定任务监督基线,而最强的专业预测基础模型仍然领先。 在长距离ETT和天气基准上,TimeBraid-2.5B实现了第二位平均MSE级和第三位平均MAE级. 我们看到,它在很大程度上保留了TimesFM2.5的单式预测能力,预计这一差距将通过更平衡的数据配方加以缩小。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We organize the ablations around six research questions that arise when transplanting the unified-multimodal recipe to time series: where the cross-modal interaction should live ( RQ1 ), whether perception and forecasting need separate towers ( RQ2 ), whether the two training objectives can coexist stably ( RQ3 ), how learning rate and data should be split between them ( RQ4 ), whether the alignment stage is necessary at all ( RQ5 ), and how strongly the forecast should draw on text at inference ( RQ6 ). For RQ1–RQ4, each panel of Figure 4 compares runs that are trained for 10k steps on the alignment dataset and differ only in the ablated factor, and we analyze the loss curves of language modeling loss and time-series loss. For RQ5, we compare full recipes on downstream benchmarks (Figure 5 ); for RQ6, we sweep the inference-time text weight of the final model (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们围绕将统一-多式配方移植到时间序列时出现的六个研究问题组织:跨模式互动应在哪里生活(RQ1),知觉和预测是否需要单独的塔(RQ2),两个培训目标是否可以稳定共存(RQ3),学习率和数据应如何在它们之间分割(RQ4),配对阶段是否完全必要(RQ5),预测在推论时应如何强烈地借鉴文本(RQ6). 对于RQ1-RQ4,每个图4的面板比较了在对齐数据集上为10k步训练的运行,并且只在减速系数上有所区别,我们分析语言模型丢失和时间序列损失的损失曲线. 对于RQ5,我们比较下游基准的完整食谱(图5);对于RQ6,我们扫描最终模型的推断时间文本权重(图6).

Insets zoom into the last 2k steps; lower is better.

blocks.en: We pivot the investigation of the proper interaction space on understanding tasks. The mainstream multimodal information fusion for understanding in vision–language models is an MLP connector that projects the visual modality into the language representation space ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and some time-series language models inherit this recipe ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . Whether the language space is an equally good host for temporal representations has not been fully examined. Panel A compares the VLM-like MLP projector with the global residual attention we used in the final architecture. With the projector, the language loss plateaus early at roughly twice the level that residual attention reaches, and the gap never closes. We observe that the language space is a poor projection target for temporal representations, and the time-series patches are often projected to be global statistics such as mean and standard deviation. The two pretrained models align much more easily in a new shared space that favors neither geometry, which also aligns with the previous findings in the limits of alignment in vision, language, and time-series representations ( Yashwante and Yu, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查了解任务的适当互动空间。 在视觉-语言模型中理解的主流多式联运信息聚合是一个MLP连接器,将视觉模式投射到语言代表空间(Liu等人,2023年),一些时间序列语言模型继承了这种配方(Xie等人,2024年). 语言空间是否同样是时间表达的很好的宿主,还没有得到充分的研究. 小组讨论会 A比较了VLM类的MLP投影仪和我们在最终架构中使用的全球剩余关注. 与投影仪相比,语言损失高原早期大约是剩余注意力所达到的两倍,缺口从不缩小. 我们观察到,语言空间对于时间表达来说是一个差的预测目标,时间序列补丁常常被预测为平均和标准偏差等全球统计. 这两个预先训练过的模型在既不倾向于几何的新的共享空间中更加容易地对齐,这也与之前在视觉,语言和时间序列表达的对齐限制(Yashwante和Yu, 2026)中的结论一致.

blocks.en: Unified vision models find that understanding and generation favor different representations and decouple them accordingly ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , which suggests giving perception and forecasting separate time-series towers. Panel E tests this hypothesis: the tri-tower variant initializes an independent perception expert and forecasting expert from the pretrained time-series models, while the dual-tower model uses the same time-series model to process both perception and forecasting streams. The two trajectories are nearly identical on both losses throughout training. Unlike vision understanding and generation, a shared temporal representation space is capable of processing information for perception and forecasting. We leave the study of using different time-series foundation models for different experts for future work.
blocks.zh: 统一愿景模型发现,理解和生成有利于不同的表述,并相应地将其脱钩(Deng等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年b),这建议给出感知和预测单独的时序塔. 小组讨论会 E测试这个假说:三塔变体从预先训练的时间序列模型中初始化一位独立感知专家和预测专家,而双塔模型则使用相同的时间序列模型来处理感知和预测流. 在整个培训过程中,两种轨迹几乎相同。 与视觉理解和生成不同,共享的时间代表空间能够处理用于感知和预测的信息. 我们暂不研究如何在今后工作中为不同的专家使用不同的时间序列基础模型。

blocks.en: The regression loss suffers from its scale-sensitive property. On strongly non-stationary segments, where future values depart from the history statistics, the time-series loss can grow arbitrarily large. Panel C shows that this failure mode is real. With plain causal RevIN ( Kim et al., 2022 ) , the time-series loss spikes recurrently over several orders of magnitude (C2), and every spike disrupts the language loss through the shared updates (C1). We find that these large spikes often cause the pretrained language representation to be corrupted. Robust normalization together with loss capping removes both symptoms and keeps the time-series loss stably and quietly optimized.
blocks.zh: 回归损失因其具有规模敏感性的财产而受到影响。 在极不固定的部分,即未来价值偏离历史统计的部分,时间序列损失可能任意增加。 小组讨论会 C显示这种失败模式是真实的. 由于Plain因果RevIN(Kim等人,2022年),时间序列损失猛增在几个数量级(C2)上反复出现,每个猛增通过共享更新(C1)中断语言损失. 我们发现,这些大跃进往往使预先训练的语言表现受到腐蚀. 强有力的正常化加上损失上限可以同时消除症状,并使时间序列损失保持稳健和安静的优化.

blocks.en: Time-series and language have different internal properties and learning dynamics. It is critical to harmonize their joint training to prevent malignant competition. Panel B sweeps a learning rate shared by both towers during joint training. The language loss is stable across the whole grid (B1), whereas the time-series loss clearly degrades at the largest rate (B2); the joint training therefore receives an α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 time-series loss weight in the final recipe. Panel D varies the understanding-to-forecasting data ratio. Every forecasting-heavy mixture (3:7 to 2:8) reaches the same lower time-series loss, while the balanced 5:5 mixture is clearly worse (D2), and the language loss is unchanged across all ratios (D1). We therefore adopt 3:7, which keeps the largest understanding share without giving up any forecasting optimization, in effect the Pareto point of the tested range. All three optimization ablations lead to the same conclusion: the time-series objective is far more sensitive than the language objective, and protecting it with bounded targets, a smaller learning rate, and a larger data share does not make language learning better.
blocks.zh: 时间序列和语言具有不同的内部属性和学习动态. 必须协调他们的联合培训,以防止恶性竞争。 小组讨论会 B扫射了两个塔在联合训练时共享的学习率. 整个网格(B1)的语言损失是稳定的,而时间序列损失在最大速率(B2)下明显下降;因此,联合培训在最后食谱中得到α=0.5\alpha=0.5时间序列损失重量。 小组讨论会 D 改变了理解与预测数据的比例。 每个预测-重度混合物(3:7至2:8)都达到同样较低的时间序列损失,而平衡的5:5混合物明显更差(D2),语言损失在所有比率(D1)上保持不变. 因此,我们通过3:7,保持最大的理解份额,而不放弃任何预测优化,实际上是测试范围的帕雷托点。 所有三个优化调谐都得出了相同的结论:时间序列目标远比语言目标敏感,并以有界限的目标保护它,学习率更小,数据共享更大并不能使语言学习更好.

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models conventionally align the modalities on paired data before instruction tuning ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) , but the alignment stage is costly, and its necessity is rarely tested. Figure 5 compares runs that share the same SFT recipe and differ in initialization, using either the aligned model or the pretrained towers directly. On understanding (a), the aligned initialization stays ahead at every checkpoint, with the largest margins in early training. On TimeMMD (b), the two runs are hard to separate: the curves cross repeatedly and end at nearly the same MSE. Much of TimeMMD’s text only weakly constrains the future (RQ6), so the numeric-history skills that SFT alone teaches already cover this benchmark setting. On CAF (c), where the text verifiably specifies the future, the benefit is persistent: the aligned run keeps a lower qCRPS at every checkpoint, and SFT alone never closes the gap. We keep the stage in the final recipe because alignment therefore pays where the forecast must draw on language and adds a lasting head start on understanding.
blocks.zh: 统一多式联运模式在指令调试前对配对数据的模式进行常规调整(Liu等人,2023年;Deng等人,2025年),但调试阶段费用高昂,其必要性很少经过测试. 图5比较了共享相同SFT配方且初始化程度不同的运行,直接使用对齐模型或预训塔. 根据(a)项理解,每个检查站都保持同步启动,早期培训的幅度最大。 在TimeMMD(b)上,两种运行很难分开:曲线反复交叉,以几乎相同的MSE结束. TimeMMD的大部分文本只是弱小地制约着未来(RQ6),因此仅SFT所教的数史技能就已经涵盖了这个基准设定. 关于CAF(c),文本可核查地指明未来,好处是持续的:对齐运行在每个检查站都保持较低的qCRPS,单靠SFT永远不会堵塞缺口. 我们把舞台放在最后的方位上,因为因此,在预测必须借鉴语言和在理解的基础上增加一个持久的起点时,调整就能够满足需要。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that no single text weight works across all domains. Larger λ \lambda usually helps Economy, Public Health, Agriculture, and Energy; Traffic gains little at smaller weights, Security does not improve, and Climate and Social Good change with history length. The first group receives reports on trade, petroleum, broiler markets, or influenza that address the forecast target or a direct driver. The weaker pairs are less direct. Traffic pairs national monthly vehicle miles traveled with local road counts, air travel, and long-term plans. Security pairs monthly FEMA grant amounts, which contain rare event-driven spikes, with past disasters and grant rules that do not specify the next spike’s timing or size. Environment pairs volatile daily New York AQI with broad or out-of-state reports; Climate and Social Good sometimes use reports from another period or region ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Text can therefore add little because it does not match the target, or because it does not specify an abrupt future change. In domains with weak or noisy context, a longer history can be more reliable than text-heavy mixing: Security is best without text, while Traffic and Public Health retain only small text weights at H = 128 H=128 . In contrast, Economy, Agriculture, and Environment continue to benefit from larger text weights.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,没有任何单一文本权重适用于所有领域。 交通收益很少, 安全没有改善, 第一组收到关于贸易、石油、燃烧器市场或流感的报告,涉及预测目标或直接驱动因素。 较弱的对子不太直接. 交通对接 国产月度车辆里程 与地方公路计票,空中旅行,长期规划. FEMA 的月补助金金额包含罕见的事件引发的激增, 环境不稳定的每日纽约AQI, 广泛或州外报告; 气候和社会好有时使用另一个时期或地区的报告(Liu等人,2024a)。 因此,文本可以小幅添加,因为它与目标不符,或者因为它没有指定一个突然的未来变化. 在环境薄弱或吵闹的域中,较长的历史可以比文字繁忙的混合更可靠: 安全最好没有文本,而交通和公共卫生仅保留小文本权重为H=128 H=128. 相比之下,经济、农业和环境继续受益于更大的文本权重。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Unified multimodal models differ chiefly in how a discrete language backbone hosts a continuous modality ( An et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) .
One line quantizes every input into a shared token vocabulary and trains a single next-token predictor ( Team, 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) ; a second mixes autoregressive text prediction with diffusion-style generation inside one transformer, increasingly over continuous latents ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025a ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025b ) ; a third decouples the representations serving understanding from those serving generation ( Chen et al., 2025b ) .
Omni-modal systems extend these recipes to speech, audio, and video ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
Two lessons recur across this progression: continuous signals lose fidelity when forced through a discrete vocabulary ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , and understanding and generation favor different treatments of the same modality.
Yet time series, for all their ubiquity, remain largely absent from these systems.
TimeBraid carries both lessons to this missing modality: it aligns time series with language in continuous space, avoiding quantization at both input and output, and gives perception and forecasting different input processing while sharing one time-series backbone.
blocks.zh:
统一的多式联运模式在离散语言主干网如何托管持续模式方面主要不同(An等人,2026年;Tong等人,2026年)。
一行将每条输入量量化为一个共同的符号词汇,并训练一个单一的下一手的预测器(Team, 2024;Zhan等人, 2024;Wang等人, 2024);第二行将自动递归文本预测与一个变压器内部的传播式生成混合在一起,越来越超越连续潜伏(Zhou等人,2025a); 谢等人,2025年a; Deng等人,2025年;Xie等人,2025年b;第三种将服务于一代人的理解的表述脱钩(Chen等人,2025年b)。
Omni模式系统将这些配方扩展到语音、音频和视频(徐等人,2025a); Cui等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年).
在这个过程中,两个教训反复出现:连续的信号在通过离散的词汇强迫下失去忠贞性(Fan等人,2025年),理解和生成倾向于同一模式的不同处理。
然而,这些系统中仍然基本上没有时间序列。
TimeBraid将两个教训都带给这个缺失模式:它将时间序列与连续空间中的语言对齐,避免在输入和输出时进行量化,在共享一个时间序列主干线的同时给予感知和预测不同的输入处理.

blocks.en:
Pretraining on large signal corpora yields foundation models that forecast zero-shot across domains ( Garza et al., 2023 ; Rasul et al., 2023 ; Das et al., 2023 ; Ansari et al., 2024 ; Woo et al., 2024 ) .
The family has since diversified along axes familiar from language modeling: sparse experts ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , long-context and serial scaling ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , generative decoding ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , compact multi-task backbones ( Goswami et al., 2024 ; Ekambaram et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) , and domain specialization ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) .
Yet the interface stays numeric: domain knowledge and instructions have no way in and explanations no way out, even though textual context can materially improve forecasts ( Williams et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) .
TimeBraid builds on this line, initializing its perception and forecasting experts from pretrained time-series blocks to inherit their temporal competence, while adding the language interface and world knowledge these models lack.
blocks.zh:
对大型信号公司进行预先训练后产生预测跨域零射度的基础模型(Garza等人,2023年;Rasul等人,2023年;Das等人,2023年;Ansari等人,2024年;Woo等人,2024年)。
从那时起,家庭沿着从语言建模中熟悉的轴线多样化:专家稀少(Shi等人,2025年),长文和系列缩放(Liu等人,2025年a); 刘等人,2026年),基因解码(刘等人,2025b),紧凑的多任务骨干. (Goswami等人,2024年;Ekambaram等人,2024年;Gao等人,2024年;Xiao等人,2025年),以及域名专业化(Cohen等人,2025年)。
然而,界面仍保持数字化:域知识与指令无从进入,解释也无从解答,尽管文字背景可以实质性地改进预测(Williams等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年a).
TimeBraid基于此线,初始化其感知和预测专家从经过预先训练的时间序列块继承其时间能力,同时添加这些模型缺乏的语言界面和世界知识.

blocks.en:
Work coupling time series with language typically picks one pretrained host and moves the other modality into it.
Understanding models host series in an LLM through an attached encoder or projector ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Guan et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Langer et al., 2025 ) , even when that encoder is itself a pretrained time-series foundation model ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Forecasting models host series in a language or vision–language model via digit serialization ( Gruver et al., 2023 ) , input reprogramming or adaptation ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) , or rendered images ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) ; conversely, context-aided forecasters host text in a numeric model through an added text branch ( Liu et al., 2024a ) .
All of these cover only one direction of the interface, and the move itself is lossy: alignment between time-series, vision, and language representations has clear limits ( Yashwante and Yu, 2026 ) , and on purely numeric benchmarks the language host adds little ( Tan et al., 2024 ) .
The few models covering both directions pay a different price: ChatTime hosts values in an LLM vocabulary as discrete tokens ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , TimeOmni-VL hosts them in pixel space as rendered plots ( Guan et al., 2026b ) , and the concurrent Chronicle learns a joint space from scratch with 324M parameters, forgoing pretrained competence on both sides ( Quinlan et al., 2026 ) .
TimeBraid instead keeps each modality in its own pretrained host and fuses the two in a shared representation space, covering both directions without forcing either modality into the other’s geometry.
blocks.zh:
与语言的工作耦合时间序列一般会选择一个预先训练过的宿主,并将另一种模式移动到其中.
通过附加编码器或投影器了解LLM中的模型主机系列(Xie等人,2024年;Guan等人,2026a年; Wang et al., 2025b; Langer et al., 2025 ),即使该编码器本身是预先训练的时间序列基础模型(Yu et al., 2025 ).
通过数字序列化(Gruver等人,2023年),输入重编或改编(Jin等人,2024年;Chang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年b年),或制作图像(Zhong等人,2025年);反之,上下文辅助预报员通过新增文本分支在数字模型中主持文字(Liu等人,2024年a年)。
所有这些只涵盖界面的一个方向,移动本身是失落的:时间序列,视觉和语言表现之间的对接有明确的限制(Yashwante和Yu, 2026),在纯粹的数值基准上,语言主机增加不多(Tan等人, 2024).
涵盖两个方向的少数模式付出了不同的代价: ChatTime主机在LLM词汇中作为离散符号值(Wang等人,2025a),Time Omni-VL在像素空间中作为制作的地块(Guan et al., 2026b)托管它们,同时"纪事报"从零开始学习一个带有324M参数的联合空间,放弃了双方预先训练的能力(Quinlan et al., 2026).
而TimeBraid则将每种模式保留在自己经过预先训练的主机中,并将这两种模式置于一个共同的表示空间中,既覆盖两个方向,又不强迫两种模式进入对方的几何。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: TimeBraid is our early attempt toward unified time-series and language models. It is trained without a continued pretraining stage. Public interleaved series–text corpora at pretraining scale are not yet mature, so our recipe moves directly from alignment to supervised fine-tuning. Arguably, large-scale continued pretraining would instill broader and richer world knowledge and improve the model across the board.
blocks.zh: TimeBraid是我们争取统一时间序列和语言模式的早期尝试. 培训没有持续的培训阶段。 公共互页系列 — text Corpora的预训规模尚未成熟,因此我们的食谱直接从对齐到监督的微调. 可以说,大规模的持续前期培训将注入更广泛和更丰富的世界知识,全面改进模式。

blocks.en: Perception carries bounded numeric precision. The model sometimes hallucinates the value at a specific point and misreads complex waveforms (long, high-frequency, or low signal-to-noise). Training coverage contributes, but the main reason is the patch tokenization inherited from the time-series backbone, which compresses many raw values into each embedding and does not fully preserve grounded local detail.
blocks.zh: 知觉带有定界数字精度. 该模型有时会在某一点产生幻觉值,误读复杂的波形(长,高频,或低信号对噪声). 训练覆盖范围有贡献,但主要原因是从时间序列骨干中继承的补丁符号化,将许多原始值压缩到每个嵌入中,并不完全保留本地的根基细节.

blocks.en: Forecast control weakens when text contradicts history. The forecasting expert inherits the transition dynamics of its pretrained backbone, which bias it toward historically consistent continuations. Direct control signals that demand behavior at odds with the history (an abrupt level shift, a sudden regime break) are followed loosely. Furthermore, large-scale high-quality real-world text-conditioned forecasting data and multi-modal multi-variate data are not readily available in public access. When the input text guidance and content are highly complex and noisy, TimeBraid cannot completely translate it to effective forecasting signals. However, we see that using a frontier language model for reasoning and instruction conversion helps mitigate these issues, and it implies the need for combination with agents for a better forecasting system.
blocks.zh: 当文本与历史相矛盾时,预测控制会减弱. 预测专家继承了它经过预先训练的骨干结构的过渡动力,它偏向于历史上一贯的延续. 要求行为与历史不符的直接控制信号(突然水平转移,突然政权断绝)被松散跟踪. 此外,大规模高质量的真实世界文本条件预报数据和多式多变数据不易公开查阅。 当输入文本引导和内容高度复杂和吵闹时,TimeBraid无法将其完全转化为有效的预报信号. 然而,我们认为,使用前沿语言模型进行推理和教学转换有助于减轻这些问题,这意味着需要与代理人结合,以建立一个更好的预报系统。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented TimeBraid, a unified time-series and language model that aligns the native representations of a pretrained language model and pretrained time-series foundation models through tri-expert global residual attention. Trained with a dual-stage recipe on curated alignment pairs and a broad instruction mixture, one set of weights understands and generates both modalities, forecasting at the level of dedicated time-series foundation models while remaining competitive with far larger general-purpose models on understanding and context-aided forecasting. Our ablations distill the design choices that make this model class work: where the cross-modal interaction should live, whether perception and forecasting need separate experts, and how strongly the forecast should draw on text at inference. We hope TimeBraid is a step toward unified models that treat time-series as an essential modality, understood and generated in its native representation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了TimeBraid,这是一个统一的时序和语言模型,通过三位专家的全球剩余关注,使预先训练的语言模型和预先训练的时间序列基础模型的本土表述保持一致。 一套加权法以双阶段配对制配对制和广义指导混合制培训,理解并生成两种模式,在专门时间序列基础模型一级进行预测,同时在理解和上下文辅助预测方面与更大范围的通用模型保持竞争力。 我们提炼出设计选择,使这一模式类发挥作用:跨模式互动应在哪里生活,感知和预测是否需要独立的专家,以及预测应在多大程度上在推论中借鉴文本。 我们希望 " 时空救援 " 是朝着统一模式迈出的一步,这种模式将时间序列视为一种基本模式,在其本土代表性中被理解和产生。

blocks.en: A.1 Univariate Understanding
blocks.zh: A.1 不同理解

blocks.en: Univariate understanding data teaches the model to recognize temporal patterns and express them in language. We use vision-language models as the primary annotators because their exposure to charts and visual data equips them to perceive global morphology, such as trends, seasonality, and regime changes, together with local events such as peaks, troughs, and anomalies. Their annotations distill this temporal knowledge into textual supervision. For real series, each evidence pack combines the observed trace with deterministic statistics, extrema, trend segments, change points, periodic patterns, and temporal landmarks; the context-rich route additionally supplies domain semantics and calendar information. Separately, we adopt the attribute-first synthesis scheme of ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , in which sampled temporal attributes determine both the generated series and its programmable description. We also rewrite procedurally generated exam prompts on pattern recognition, noise, similarity, anomalies, and Granger-causal structure into concise descriptive-answer supervision. All outputs pass factual, stylistic, and formatting filters.
blocks.zh: 异变理解数据教模型识别时态并用语言表达. 我们使用视觉语言模型作为主要的注释者,因为他们接触到图表和视觉数据,就能够让他们感知全球形态,如趋势、季节性和制度变化,以及地方事件,如高峰、槽和异常。 他们的注解将这种时空知识提炼成文字监督. 对于真正的系列,每个证据包将观测到的微量数据与确定性统计数据、极端数据、趋势段、变化点、周期规律和时间标志结合起来;环境丰富的路线额外提供域语义和日历信息。 另外,我们采用了ChatTS的属性第一合成方案(Xie等人,2024年),其中抽样的时间属性决定生成的序列及其可编程描述. 我们还将程序生成的关于模式识别、噪音、相似性、异常和Granger-causal结构的考试提示重写为简明的描述式回答监督。 所有产出都经过事实、形式和格式化过滤器。

blocks.en: A.2 Multivariate Understanding
blocks.zh: A.2 多变理解

blocks.en: Real multivariate time series rarely carry detailed, verifiable annotations of interactions across variables. We retain the cleaned multivariate descriptions from ChatTS ( Xie et al., 2024 ) for broad descriptive coverage and construct graph-grounded relational supervision with temporal structural equation models. The source generator samples sparse or random lagged graphs over 3 to 50 observed variables with maximum lags from 2 to 50 steps, then simulates their multivariate trajectories. Each evidence pack records the graph-authorized variable roles, lag offsets, intervention metadata when present, temporal anchors, and canonical evidence for direct parent-to-target relations, short directed chains, localized shock follow-ons, historical reference windows from the same SCM, and local parent/child motifs. A text-only LLM converts this evidence into natural descriptions under automatic grounding checks. The active mixture contains 100,000 SCM descriptions, including 74,210 positive relation examples and 25,790 comparison controls whose channels are not directly adjacent to the target.
blocks.zh: 真正的多变时间序列很少包含详细,可核查的变量间相互作用的说明. 我们保留了来自ChatTS(Xie等人,2024年)的清理多变量描述,以进行广泛的描述性覆盖,并用时间结构方程式模型构建以图表为基础的关系监督。 源生成器对3至50个观测到的变量进行稀疏或随机的滞后图样本,最大滞后从2至50步,然后模拟其多变轨迹. 每个证据包都记录图形授权的可变角色、滞后抵消、在场时的干预元数据、时间锚定、直接父母与目标关系、短方向链、局部冲击跟踪、同一SCM的历史参考窗口、以及本地父母/孩子动机等证据。 只有文本的 LLM 在自动地面检查下将这种证据转换为自然描述. 活性混合物包含10万SCM描述,包括74,210个正关系实例和25,790个比较控制,其通道不直接与目标相邻.

blocks.en: A.3 Univariate Forecasting
blocks.zh: A.3 异变预测

blocks.en: Paired data that connects an observed history, a textual condition, and its corresponding future is scarce in natural corpora. We construct this supervision through the general-context and counterfactual-context pipelines in Figure 7 . The general branch annotates the realized suffix of a real window with its domain semantics and temporal information. The control branch produces three sibling continuations from one history: a baseline and two controlled variants, each composing up to three transformations drawn from level shifts, ramps, slope changes, pulses, seasonal-amplitude changes, saturations, shock decays, and analog replays. It renders the applied transformations as natural-language conditions, so the shared history can lead to distinct text-specified futures. The model input contains the observed history and the natural-language continuation condition, while time-series loss applies only to the held-out suffix. Optional genre and semantic rewrites diversify the conditions while preserving their connection to the target future. Both pipelines apply the shared factual, stylistic, and formatting filters.
blocks.zh: 连接被观测历史,文字条件的Paired数据及其相应的未来在自然蝎子中稀缺. 我们通过图7中的一般文字和反事实文字管道建立这种监督。 一般分支用其域语义和时间信息来注释一个真实窗口的实现后缀. 控制分支从一个历史中产生三个兄弟姐妹续作:一个基线和两个控制变体,每个变体由平移,坡度变化,坡度变化,脉冲变化,季节性放大变化,饱和,休克衰变,以及模拟重放所抽出的三个变体组成. 它使应用的转换成为自然语言的条件,因此共享的历史可以导致独特的文本专用的未来. 模型输入包含观测到的历史和自然语言的延续条件,而时间序列损失只适用于被搁置的后缀. 可选流派和语义重写条件多样化,同时保持与目标未来的联系. 这两种管道都采用共同的事实、形式和格式化过滤器。

blocks.en: A context segment is preceded by <stats>len= L L , mean= μ \mu , std= σ \sigma </stats> , computed on the raw values before normalization, so the text stream carries the physical scale while the patch stream carries only normalized shape. A target segment emits a bare <ts></ts> and never receives a statistics block, so the model is not told the scale of the sequence it must produce. Target segments span the full window [ history ∣ future ] [\text{history}\mid\text{future}] and reuse the mean and standard deviation of their context segment, which keeps every future-aware statistic out of the input, and only the future suffix is scored. Exam-style questions are the one family whose payload keeps raw values, because their options refer to absolute magnitudes.

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录E 评价议定书

blocks.en: For every public benchmark, we use its official split or released evaluation set and follow its official evaluation protocol and input-length setting unless stated otherwise. Ctrl-F uses our frozen evaluation set. Each paragraph below states whether baseline results are taken from an existing study or evaluated by us.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个公共基准,除非另有说明,否则我们使用其官方的拆分或发布的评价集,并遵循其官方评价协议和输入长度设定。 Ctrl - 说吧 - Ctrl F用的是我们冷冻的评价集 以下各段说明基线结果是否取自我们现有的一项研究或评估。

blocks.en: TemporalBench is a multi-domain benchmark over real numerical series that separates historical-structure interpretation (T1), context-free prediction (T2), context-grounded reasoning (T3), and event-conditioned forecasting (T4), testing whether agents can align temporal patterns with external context and adapt when conditions change. Multiple-choice tasks use accuracy; forecasting uses domain-specific MAE or sMAPE variants, where sMAPE normalizes absolute error by the magnitudes of the target and prediction and MIMIC uses the benchmark’s observation-weighted aggregation. We evaluate every model ourselves on the official TemporalBench evaluation set ( Weng et al., 2026 ) (Table 16 ).
blocks.zh: Tempolar Bench是相对于真实数值序列的多域基准,它将历史结构解释(T1),无上下文预测(T2),上下文推理(T3)和事件条件预测(T4)区分开来,测试代理人是否能够将时间规律与外部上下文一致,并在条件变化时进行调整. 多选择任务使用精度;预测使用特定域的MAE或SMAPE变体,其中SMAPE通过目标和预测的大小使绝对错误正常化,MIMIC使用基准的观测加权汇总. 我们自己在官方的Temperal Bench评价集(Weng等人,2026年)上评价每个模型(表16)。

blocks.en: TimeSeriesExam is a configurable, procedurally generated multiple-choice exam in which one or two controlled synthetic series, represented as plots or serialized values, are paired with answer options and an in-context example to test pattern and noise understanding, anomaly detection, comparative reasoning, and Granger-causality reasoning. We use the official evaluation set ( Cai et al., 2024 ) and take the shared baseline results from the TS-Reasoner paper ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . GPT-5.4, Gemini-2.5-Flash, TimeOmni-1-7B, TimeOmni-VL, and TimeBraid are additional evaluations performed by us on the same released set with its scorer (Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 时间序列 考核(Exam)是一种可配置的,程序上产生的多选题考试,其中以图案或序列值为代表的一两个受控合成系列与答案选项和一个内文本实例配对,以测试图案和噪音理解,异常检测,比较推理,以及格兰杰-causality推理. 我们使用官方评价集(Cai等人,2024年),并取TS-Reasoner论文(Yu等人,2025年)的共享基线结果. GPT-5.4,双子座2.5-Flash,TimeOmni-1-7B,TimeOmni-VL,以及TimeBraid,是我们用其计分器发布的同一集进行的额外评价(表12)。

blocks.en: TSAQA formulates each instance as a numerical series, natural-language context, and a true-or-false, multiple-choice, or puzzling question, spanning anomaly detection and classification together with characterization, comparison, data transformation, and temporal-relation reasoning. Puzzling questions ask the model to reorder four shuffled successor patches and are scored by the fraction placed in the correct position. We use the official test set ( Jing et al., 2026 ) ; except for GPT-5.4, the LLM and finetuned baseline results are taken from the TSAQA paper, while GPT-5.4, the time-series language models, and the unified models are evaluated by us on the same 42,000 cases with the paper-defined scoring rule (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: TSAQA将每个实例表述为数字序列,自然语境,以及真假,多选择,或令人费解的问题,跨越异常的检测和分类,与特征,比较,数据转换,以及时间关系推理一起进行. 模糊问题要求模型重排4个洗牌继任补丁,并被放置在正确位置的分数打分. 我们使用官方的测试集(Jing等人,2026年);除了GPT-5.4,LLM和微调的基准结果取自TSAQA论文,而GPT-5.4,时间序列语言模型,以及统一模型则由我们用纸定义的评分规则在同一42,000个案例中进行评估(表13).

blocks.en: In its primary captioning task, CaTS-Bench pairs raw time-indexed values with contextual metadata, a line plot, and a standardized instruction, asking models to synthesize numerical, visual, and semantic evidence into a grounded description evaluated against human-rewritten references. Embedding and lexical metrics measure semantic and wording consistency with the reference; Numeric Fidelity extracts numbers from the reference and output and combines their matching precision and recall. We use the official human-rewritten evaluation set ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , take the available baseline results from the CaTS-Bench paper, and evaluate GPT-5.4, the time-series language models, and the unified models ourselves on the same set with the six released-formula local metrics (Table 14 ); the separate Gemini-dependent Numeric Score 2.0 is not a column in that table.
blocks.zh: CATS-Bench在其主要标题任务中,将原始时间索引值与上下文元数据、行图和标准化指示成对,要求模型将数字、视觉和语义证据综合成根据人文改写的参考资料加以评价的有根据描述。 嵌入式和词典式衡量语义和措辞与引用的一致性; 数字Fidelity从引用和输出中提取数字,并将其匹配的精度和召回性结合起来. 我们使用官方的人文重写评价集(Zhou et al., 2026),取CATS-Bench论文的现有基准结果,并评价GPT-5.4,时间序列语言模型,以及统一模型自己在同一集上与六个释放的方程式本地度量衡(表14),独立的双子依赖数分数2.0不是该表中的一栏.

blocks.en: CiK comprises 71 probabilistic forecasting tasks across seven domains, each paired with historical, future, covariate, causal, or intemporal natural-language context that is essential beyond the observed numerical history, and tests whether models integrate both modalities. RCRPS emphasizes context-relevant future regions, penalizes violations of textual constraints, and normalizes scores by task scale; we aggregate it using the official task weights. We evaluate every model ourselves on the official 355-instance CiK evaluation set ( Williams et al., 2024 ) (Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: CiK包含71个概率预测任务,涉及7个领域,每个领域都与历史、未来、共变、因果或时空自然语言背景相结合,而这些背景在观测到的数字历史之外至关重要,并测试模型是否结合了两种模式。 RCRPS强调与背景相关的未来区域,惩罚违反文字限制的行为,并按任务规模使分数正常化;我们用正式任务权重加以汇总. 我们自己在正式的355-Instance CiK评价集(Williams等人,2024年)(表15)上评价每个模型。

blocks.en: Time-MMD evaluates multimodal forecasting across nine real-world domains by pairing numerical histories with temporally aligned historical text at four frequency-dependent horizons, testing whether extra-numerical domain knowledge improves prediction. We report each domain’s MSE and MAE macro-averaged over its four horizons. We use the official evaluation split ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Every row of Table 18 is evaluated by us, with each multimodal forecasting model receiving the window’s paired text: GPT4MTS, TaTS, Time-VLM ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) , the text-enhanced PatchTST ∗ (VoT style ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ), iTransformer ∗ , and RaFT ∗ , and the additional DLinear, Reformer (MMTSFlib style ( Liu et al., 2024a ) ), and Time-LLM runs. TimeBraid, all time-series foundation models, and MIGAS-1.5 use a fixed 128-step lookback; the text-conditioned baselines, ChatTime, and Aurora use the official lookbacks of 8, 36, and 96. We select a single text-mixing weight of λ = 0.3 \lambda=0.3 on the validation split and then hold it fixed across all nine domains and history lengths, rather than tuning it separately for each dataset; this uniform setting simplifies evaluation and tests generality across domains.
blocks.zh: Time-MMD评价跨越9个现实世界域的多式联运预测,方法是在四个频率依赖的地平线上将数字历史与时间对齐的历史文本对齐,测试数字外域知识是否改善了预测. 我们报告每个域的MSE和MAE的宏观平均值, 我们使用官方评价分拆(Liu等人,2024a). 表18的每行都由我们评估,每个多式联运预测模型都收到窗口的配对文本: GPT4MTS,TATS,Time-VLM(钟等,2025年),文字增强的PatchTST *(VoT风格(王等,2026年)),iTransformer *,和RaFT *,以及附加的DLinear,Reformer(MMTSFlib风格(刘等,2024a)),Time-LLM运行. TimeBraid),所有时间序列基础模型,和MIGAS-1.5使用固定的128步回望;文本有条件的基线ChatTime,和Aurora使用8,36和96的官方回望. 我们在验证分拆上选择一个= 0.3\lambda=0.3的单一文本混合权重,然后将其固定在所有九个域和历史长度上,而不是为每个数据集单独调整;这种统一的设置简化了评估和测试跨域的通用性.

blocks.en: CGTSF uses the chronological 6:2:2 splits of MSPG, LEU, and PTF, pairing histories with leakage-controlled background, weather-forecast, and calendar information to test the auxiliary role of text in forecasting at four history lengths per dataset. We standardize errors using training-split statistics and report Macro MSE and Macro MAE as the equal averages across the twelve dataset × \times history-length settings. We evaluate every model ourselves on the released CGTSF datasets using the paper-defined splits ( Wang et al., 2025a ) (Table 19 ). We adopt the same implementation of the dataset-specific baselines as in the Time-MMD evaluation.
blocks.zh: CGTSF使用时间顺序为6:2:2的MSPG,LEU,和PTF的分割,将历史与渗漏控制背景,天气预测,和日历信息对齐,以测试文本在每个数据集四个历史长度的预测中的辅助作用. 我们利用培训分解统计数据将错误标准化,并将Macro MSE和Macro MAE报告为12个数据集×\时间历史长度设置的等平均值。 我们自己利用纸面定义的分数(Wang等人,2025年a)(表19),对公布的CGTSF数据集中的每个模型进行评估。 我们采用与时间-MMD评价相同的数据集特定基线。

blocks.en: CAF-7M evaluates context-aided probabilistic forecasting on verified history–scenario–future windows from datasets reserved for testing, with contexts designed to provide information complementary to the numerical history. Normalized CRPS evaluates the full predictive distribution after adjusting for target scale. We use the official evaluation split ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; DoubleCast and TimeLLM are taken from the CAF-7M paper, and all remaining rows are evaluated by us under the same official protocol (Table 21 ).
blocks.zh: CAF-7M评价了从保留用于测试的数据集对已核实历史-情景-未来窗口进行上下文协助的概率预测,其上下文旨在提供补充数字历史的信息。 正常化的CRPS在对目标尺度进行调整后评价全部预测分布. 我们使用官方评价分拆(郑等人,2026年);双卡斯特和TimeLLM取自CAF-7M的论文,其余各行由我们根据同一官方协议进行评估(表21).

blocks.en: Ctrl-F is our controlled-future test set, built on numerical histories replayed from held-out GIFT-Eval test anchors. Each history is paired with three deliberately separated synthetic future siblings and a condition identifying the intended continuation, testing whether forecasts follow the condition rather than the shared history alone. The sibling futures are constructed counterfactual targets rather than official GIFT targets, generated with the same procedure used for the control rows of the alignment corpus. Top-1 is correct when a prediction has lower MAE to its intended sibling than to either alternative, with a chance level of 33.33 % 33.33\% . We evaluate every model ourselves on the fixed Ctrl-F evaluation set using the same evaluation protocol (Table 21 ).
blocks.zh: Ctrl-F是我们的可控未来测试集, 以数字历史为基础, 从被搁置的GIFT-Eval测试锚地重播。 每个历史都与三个故意分离的合成未来兄弟姐妹配对,并有一个条件,确定预期的延续,检验预测是否遵循条件,而不是仅仅遵循共同的历史. 姊妹期货是构建的反事实目标,而不是官方的GIFT目标,其生成程序与用于校对指令控制行的程序相同. 当一个预测的MAE低于其预想的兄弟姐妹时,Top-1是正确的,其概率水平为33.33% 33.33% 。 我们利用同样的评价协议,对固定的Ctrl-F评价组中的每个模型自己进行评估(表21)。

blocks.en: GIFT-Eval evaluates general zero-shot point and probabilistic forecasting across 97 dataset–frequency–horizon configurations spanning univariate and multivariate series, seven domains, ten sampling frequencies, and short-to-long horizons, targeting generalization across heterogeneous forecasting settings. The official leaderboard’s MASE scales absolute point error by seasonal-naive error, while CRPS evaluates the predictive distribution; both are normalized against Seasonal Naive per configuration and aggregated by geometric mean, so lower is better and 1.0 matches Seasonal Naive. We take baseline results from the official leaderboard ( Aksu et al., 2024 ) and evaluate TimeBraid using the last 2,880 history points (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: GIFT-Eval 评估了97个数据集(频率-视距配置)的一般零射点和概率预测,这些配置跨越无偏差和多变量系列、7个域、10个采样频率和短到长的地平线,针对不同预测环境的通用。 官方领导板的MASE比例绝对点误差是季节性-负性误差,而CRPS则评价预测分布;两者都与每个配置的季节性Naive(seasonal Naive)相对常态化,并按几何平均值进行汇总,因此较低值更好,1.0与季节性Naive(季性Naive)匹配. 我们从官方领导板(Aksu等人, 2024年)中获得基线结果,

blocks.en: Long-term forecasting follows the standard multivariate setting on ETTm1, ETTm2, ETTh1, ETTh2, and the 21-variable Jena Weather dataset at horizons { 96,192,336,720 } \{96,192,336,720\} , testing numerical-history-only extrapolation of trends, periodic structure, and long-range dependencies ( Zhou et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2021 ) . TimeBraid-2.5B and the time-series foundation models are evaluated zero-shot, while the task-specific supervised baselines are trained on each dataset. Most baseline results are taken from the Sundial and Time-MoE papers ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . We additionally evaluate TimesFM 2.5 and Chronos-2 ourselves, using the same 2,880-step lookback windows as TimeBraid (Table 22 ).
blocks.zh: 长期预测遵循了ETTm1,ETTm2,ETTH1,ETTH2上的标准多变量设置和地平线上21可变的耶拿天气数据集{96,192,336,720}} \{96,192,336,720 \},测试仅用数字-历史推算趋势,周期结构,以及远距离依赖性(周 al等人,2021年;吴 al等人,2021年). TimeBraid-2.5B和时间序列基础模型被评价为零镜头,而任务特定监督基线则在每个数据集上进行培训. 大多数基线结果取自Sundial和Time-MoE文件(Liu等人,2025年b); Shi等人,2025年 ). 我们还利用与TimeBraid相同的2 880步回望窗口(表22),自己评估TimesFM 2.5和Chronos-2。

blocks.zh: 为了检查联合培训是否保留了预先训练的语言塔的语言能力,我们在每个培训阶段结束时对MMLU上的TimeBraid进行评估. 我们还培训一种将单模式数据混合到对齐阶段的变体,在对齐的例子的同时重播Stage-2单模式公司(表8)。 在表23中,我们报告这些检查站的MMLU准确性。

blocks.en: From the table, the alignment stage costs the language tower 19.4 points, and mixing unimodal data into this stage recovers MMLU to 53.4. After supervised fine-tuning, the two variants end within 0.6 points of each other, since the fine-tuning mixture already contains an 11.69% unimodal share. We therefore keep the alignment stage purely paired. Overall, mixing unimodal data preserves the language ability of the unified model, although the shares we use do not preserve it fully and leave the released model 9.6 points below its backbone. We leave the search for a unimodal ratio that removes this gap to future work.
blocks.zh: 从表中看,对齐阶段花费了语言塔19.4分,将单式数据混合到这一阶段后,MMLU恢复到53.4. 在经过监督的微调后,两个变体在彼此的0.6点内结束,因为微调混合物已经包含11.69%的单式份额. 因此,我们保持完全对接阶段。 总体而言,混合单模式数据保留了统一模式的语言能力,尽管我们使用的股份并不完全保存,并将发布的模式9.6点置于其骨干之下. 我们不再寻找一种单一模式的比率,以消除与今后工作的差距。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Text-controlled forecasting on held-out test histories. Each group uses three textual conditions with the same numerical input. Colored curves are recorded model outputs; the text below each panel quotes the differing condition. These are constructed scenarios, not observed alternative futures. Full histories and complete forecast horizons are shown on separate horizontal axes with the same vertical scale.
blocks.zh: 图11:关于搁置试验历史的文本控制预测。 每组使用三个文本条件,数字输入相同. 彩色曲线是记录的模型输出;每个面板下面的文字引用不同的条件. 这些是构建的假想,没有观察到的替代期货. 完整的历史和完整的预测地平线显示在具有相同垂直尺度的独立的水平轴上.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Additional text-controlled forecasts on held-out histories. All three predictions use the displayed textual conditions, quoted from the full inputs. The constructed scenarios vary trends, levels, and local changes; they illustrate the model’s responses to distinct instructions. Both axes use the same vertical scale and display the complete input and output sequences.
blocks.zh: 图 12: 对搁置历史进行额外的文本控制预测。 所有三种预测都使用显示的文字条件,引用了全部输入. 所构建的情景不同趋势、水平和地方变化;它们说明了模型对不同指示的反应。 两轴都使用相同的垂直尺度,并显示完整的输入和输出序列.

blocks.en: Figure 13: Selected Time-MMD test forecasts with matched contextual-text ablations. Orange uses the full dataset-provided textual context; dashed blue removes that context while retaining the same forecast instruction, numerical history, and horizon. Dashed gray is the observed future. Text below each panel is a verbatim excerpt of the full context used for prediction. MAE is measured over the complete future horizon in source units; reductions describe these selected examples.
